Name: R1
Subtitle: Realm of Crystal Dawn
PeopleText: Farmers whose skin catches light like cut glass.
Custom: The Chime Harvest: wheat is rung like bells at dawn before it is cut.

SideQuest.title: Weeding the Black
SideQuest.text: Rot sprouts keep creeping out of the fields. Put down 6 roaming foes so we can replant.
SideQuest.done: The wheat rings clean again. Thank you.

Name: R2
Subtitle: Realm of the Endless Forge
PeopleText: Stout smiths with coal-dark skin and veins that glow when they lie.
Custom: Quench-oaths: a promise is made by plunging your hand into the cooling barrel.

SideQuest.title: Oath Unbroken
SideQuest.text: Before he fell, Pyrrhos hid his last honest blade by the Anvil of Oaths. Find it.
SideQuest.done: An unbroken blade. Proof he was good once.

Name: R3
Subtitle: Realm of Drowned Crowns
PeopleText: Gill-necked singers who live in palaces of pearl.
Custom: Tide-songs: every family owns one verse of the song that pulls the tide in.

SideQuest.title: The Missing Verses
SideQuest.text: Our tide-song lost verses when families fled. Open the 4 sunken chests where they hid their scrolls.
SideQuest.done: The song is whole. The tide will come home.

Name: R4
Subtitle: Realm of the Broken Sky
PeopleText: Hollow-boned windriders who never touch the ground twice in a day.
Custom: First-flight: children leap from the Spire of Firsts on their tenth birthday.

SideQuest.title: Grounded Flock
SideQuest.text: Storm-beasts keep the young Aerin from their first flight. Clear 8 of them out of the sky lanes.
SideQuest.done: Six kids flew today. Six!

Name: R5
Subtitle: Realm of Waking Nightmares
PeopleText: Shades who sold their sleep and now cannot stop seeing.
Custom: Naming: you are not an adult until you say your worst nightmare aloud.

SideQuest.title: Say It Aloud
SideQuest.text: I am too scared to go to the Naming Stone alone. Will you stand there for me?
SideQuest.done: I said it. It was smaller out loud.

Name: R6
Subtitle: Heart of the First Lattice
PeopleText: Animate shards of the Heart, loyal to whoever holds the most light.
Custom: None remain. The Crown has been silent since the Heart broke.

SideQuest.title: Nine Reflections
SideQuest.text: The Mirror of Nine still shows the Heart as it was. Go look into it, and remember what we are saving.
SideQuest.done: Whole. It was so beautiful whole.

Name: R7
Subtitle: Realm of Measured Stars
PeopleText: Four-armed scholars who mapped the Lattice and built the first Rift Gates.
Custom: Every Quorin child is given a star to measure for life.

SideQuest.title: Bells Out of Tune
SideQuest.text: Rift creatures detune the Resonance Bells by gnawing on them. Clear out 8 so I can recalibrate.
SideQuest.done: Perfect pitch. Gates One through Eight now open on command.

Name: R8
Subtitle: Realm of Hungry Green
PeopleText: Bark-skinned people who root at night and wander by day.
Custom: Seed-naming: a newborn is named after the first seed that sprouts in their cradle soil.

SideQuest.title: Cradle Soil
SideQuest.text: Our cradle seeds were stolen to feed the Maw. Recover the 4 hidden seed caches.
SideQuest.done: Four hundred names, saved.

Name: R9
Subtitle: Realm of the Mirrored Dunes
PeopleText: Lizard-folk nomads who navigate by the songs of the sand.
Custom: Water-debt: a cup of water given is a debt owed for a generation.

SideQuest.title: The Sundial's Shadow
SideQuest.text: Our old navigator vanished near the Sunken Sundial. Find out what happened.
SideQuest.done: Kesh is alive? That stubborn lizard!

Name: R10
Subtitle: Realm of the Long Winter
PeopleText: Shaggy giants who carve their histories into glaciers.
Custom: Fire-sharing: no Hrim may refuse a stranger a seat at the hearth.

SideQuest.title: Chronicle in the Ice
SideQuest.text: The Glacier Chronicle names every Hrim who died this winter. Read it, so someone remembers.
SideQuest.done: Now they are remembered by someone who will leave this place. That matters.

Name: R11
Subtitle: Realm of the Wound Clock
PeopleText: Brass automatons who believe they were dreamed into being by their god.
Custom: Winding Day: once a year, every Cogborn winds another's heart-spring by hand.

SideQuest.title: Lost Spring
SideQuest.text: A small unit went missing in the Scrapyard Maze before Winding Day. Please locate it.
SideQuest.done: Unit Seven is functional. Unit Seven is... insisting on following you.

Name: R12
Subtitle: Realm of Lantern Bogs
PeopleText: Frog-folk who read fortunes in the patterns of swamp gas.
Custom: Lantern-courting: you propose by catching someone a will-o-wisp.

SideQuest.title: Wisps for Courting
SideQuest.text: Wisp Thieves stole every lantern for courting season. Clear 10 bog-beasts so the wisps come back.
SideQuest.done: Three proposals already! Fertile season.

Name: R13
Subtitle: Realm of Burning Isles
PeopleText: Scaled sailors who sail lava seas in obsidian hulls.
Custom: Burning-the-boat: a captain's first ship is always burned, so they never fear losing one.

SideQuest.title: Ashore
SideQuest.text: Drag 4 salvage chests up the beach before the tide of magma takes them.
SideQuest.done: Good haul. You could sail with us any day.

Name: R14
Subtitle: Realm of Underground Stars
PeopleText: Blind mole-folk who see by the singing of crystals.
Custom: Echo-names: you are named by the echo your first cry makes.

SideQuest.title: The Singing Vein
SideQuest.text: The Singing Vein went quiet. Go listen, and tell me what you hear.
SideQuest.done: A heartbeat? Lithos is dreaming. Good dream or bad?

Name: R15
Subtitle: Realm of Endless Grass
PeopleText: Centaur herders who follow the aurora across the grasslands.
Custom: The Long Ride: grief is carried by galloping until the sun rises.

SideQuest.title: The Long Ride
SideQuest.text: Thundering beasts scattered our foals. Put down 10 so the herd can gather.
SideQuest.done: We will ride for the lost tonight, and sing for you after.

Name: R16
Subtitle: Realm of Honored Dead
PeopleText: Skeletal monks who keep their ancestors' bones as a library.
Custom: Bone-reading: the dead are consulted by touching their knuckles.

SideQuest.title: Knuckle Library
SideQuest.text: Four reliquaries were scattered by the Herald. Return them to their places.
SideQuest.done: The ancestors have their voices back. They say you are very loud.

Name: R17
Subtitle: Realm of the Woven Sky
PeopleText: Six-limbed weavers who live in a city strung between tree-tops.
Custom: Thread-contracts: agreements are woven, and broken by cutting.

SideQuest.title: The Snapped Bridge
SideQuest.text: My sister went to mend the Snapped Bridge and has not returned.
SideQuest.done: Ysra! You found her. She says she is coming with you, which is very like her.

Name: R18
Subtitle: Realm of Singing Reefs
PeopleText: Seal-folk who shed their skins to walk the shore at night.
Custom: Skin-trust: lovers swap seal-skins for a night.

SideQuest.title: Skins for the Shore
SideQuest.text: Recover 4 chests of stolen seal-skins.
SideQuest.done: Tonight, everyone swims.

Name: R19
Subtitle: Realm of Thunder Anvils
PeopleText: Giants who forge lightning into tools.
Custom: Strike-marks: a giant's age is counted by lightning scars.

SideQuest.title: Storm Census
SideQuest.text: Too many storm-beasts. The forges cannot get lightning. Clear 12.
SideQuest.done: The anvils ring again. That is the best music.

Name: R20
Subtitle: Wound in the Lattice
PeopleText: Travelers lost between realms, half-real and fading.
Custom: Anchoring: the Unmoored hold hands to remember they exist.

SideQuest.title: Hold Their Hands
SideQuest.text: The Unmoored are fading. Open 4 anchor-caches so they can tether themselves.
SideQuest.done: They are holding on. So are we.

Name: R21
Subtitle: Realm of the Unending Night
PeopleText: Moth-winged lamplighters who have never seen a sunrise.
Custom: Wick-day: each Lumen lights one lantern a year for someone they lost.

SideQuest.title: Relight the District
SideQuest.text: The Snuffed District is dark. Clear 12 shadows so we can relight it.
SideQuest.done: Every window, glowing.

Name: R22
Subtitle: Realm of the Sick Forest
PeopleText: Tree-spirits bound to a single tree each.
Custom: Grafting: two dryads who love each other graft a branch between their trees.

SideQuest.title: The Sick Spring
SideQuest.text: The spring that feeds our roots runs black. Find its source.
SideQuest.done: Clear water. I can feel my leaves again.

Name: R23
Subtitle: Realm of Steam and Greed
PeopleText: Tiny gnomes who measure worth in patents.
Custom: Patent-feasts: a new invention is celebrated by everyone eating off it.

SideQuest.title: Back Pay
SideQuest.text: The Mint is hoarding wages. Crack 4 vault chests and give the workers their due.
SideQuest.done: Payday! First in nine years.

Name: R24
Subtitle: Realm of Eternal Spring
PeopleText: Fox-folk with many tails who brew tea as a form of prayer.
Custom: Tea-vows: a promise sworn over tea cannot be broken without losing a tail.

SideQuest.title: The Ninth Tail
SideQuest.text: My student Nimra broke a tea-vow to fight the Herald and fled in shame. Search the Nine-Tail Grove.
SideQuest.done: A broken vow to save others is kept in spirit. Tell her she can come home.

Name: R25
Subtitle: Realm of Sleeping Pyramids
PeopleText: Jackal-headed priests who weigh hearts against feathers.
Custom: Heart-weighing: every Anubari's heart is weighed at sunset, and the light ones sing.

SideQuest.title: Weigh the Scarabs
SideQuest.text: Scarab swarms are eating the feathers of judgment. Destroy 12.
SideQuest.done: Light hearts tonight.

Name: R26
Subtitle: Realm of the Naga Throne
PeopleText: Serpent-bodied nobles of an ancient sea empire.
Custom: Shed-crowning: a ruler crowns the heir with their own shed skin.

SideQuest.title: The Shed Vault
SideQuest.text: The Shed Vault holds every crown of our line. Something has broken in. Look inside.
SideQuest.done: The crowns are safe. You have my gratitude, and the Empire's.

Name: R27
Subtitle: Realm of the Eternal War
PeopleText: Orc clans for whom honor is counted in scars freely given.
Custom: Scar-gift: a warrior thanks a rival by letting them land the first blow.

SideQuest.title: Scar Wall
SideQuest.text: Rot-Turned Veterans shame the clans. Give 12 of them an honest end.
SideQuest.done: Their names go back on the Scar Wall. With honor.

Name: R28
Subtitle: Realm of the Twin Lake
PeopleText: People who exist in pairs, one in the world and one in the lake.
Custom: Twin-bonding: each Mirrorkin must say good morning to their reflection, or it goes missing.

SideQuest.title: Good Morning
SideQuest.text: Reflections are going missing. Visit the Still Point where they are kept.
SideQuest.done: Everyone said good morning today. Everyone.

Name: R29
Subtitle: Realm of the Phoenix Prairie
PeopleText: Phoenix-folk who burn and are reborn once a lifetime.
Custom: Ash-gifts: the reborn give their old ashes to someone they love.

SideQuest.title: The Cold Hearth
SideQuest.text: A hearth that freezes fire. Find it and learn what is wrong.
SideQuest.done: Nihilus' mark. It is reaching further.

Name: R30
Subtitle: Edge of the Hollow
PeopleText: Former mortals emptied by Nihilus, singing his silence.
Custom: There are none. The Choir took them.

SideQuest.title: The Mute Bell
SideQuest.text: Ring the Mute Bell and break the silence.
SideQuest.done: It rang. Everyone in the Choir turned to listen.

Name: R31
Subtitle: Realm of Floating Oceans
PeopleText: Riders of cloud-whales who never set foot on land.
Custom: Whale-songs: each family sings a whale-song so the herd knows them.

SideQuest.title: Calves Overboard
SideQuest.text: Whale-lice swarms are bleeding the calves. Clear 14.
SideQuest.done: Listen. The whole herd is singing.

Name: R32
Subtitle: Realm of the Velvet Night
PeopleText: Pale aristocrats who drink red wine of roses, not blood. Mostly.
Custom: Masquerades: no one shows their true face until a vow is made.

SideQuest.title: The Masquerade
SideQuest.text: Return 4 stolen masks hidden in the manor grounds.
SideQuest.done: Tonight, we unmask. Together.

Name: R33
Subtitle: Realm of the Fallen Star
PeopleText: Golems born from meteor-stone who hum with starlight.
Custom: Sky-watching: the Stoneborn take turns staying awake to watch for falling kin.

SideQuest.title: The Hooded Wanderer
SideQuest.text: The wanderer camps at the Crater's Eye. He asked to meet the Facetborn, if they ever came.
SideQuest.done: He went with you? Good. He looked lonely.

Name: R34
Subtitle: Realm of All Roads
PeopleText: Traders from a hundred realms who came through old gates and never left.
Custom: Haggling is sacred. Paying full price is an insult.

SideQuest.title: Lost & Found
SideQuest.text: A crate of travelers' heirlooms was stolen. Find the 4 hidden stashes.
SideQuest.done: Everyone gets their thing back. Unheard of! Wonderful!

Name: R35
Subtitle: Realm of the Elder Dragons
PeopleText: Proud winged folk descended from dragons that took mortal shape.
Custom: Hoard-giving: a Dragonkin's wealth is measured by what they give away.

SideQuest.title: Wyvern Season
SideQuest.text: Raiders harry the roosts. Clear 14.
SideQuest.done: The young can fly again.

Name: R36
Subtitle: Realm of the Fae Courts
PeopleText: Bargain-bound fairies who cannot lie but love a technicality.
Custom: Name-keeping: true names are only told to the trusted.

SideQuest.title: Nine Doors
SideQuest.text: Find the Court of Doors and pick the right one. Or the wrong one. Both are interesting.
SideQuest.done: You picked the door that led back. Clever!

Name: R37
Subtitle: Realm of Broken Time
PeopleText: People who age backward and forward depending on the hour.
Custom: Birthday-on-demand: you celebrate whenever you happen to be younger.

SideQuest.title: Old Tock
SideQuest.text: The watchmaker Tock is stuck in a loop at his workshop. Break him out.
SideQuest.done: He made it out? He will need to catch up on several decades of news.

Name: R38
Subtitle: Realm Beneath the Deepest Sea
PeopleText: Lantern-headed folk who live where sunlight is a myth.
Custom: Lure-lighting: the brightest lure leads the family.

SideQuest.title: Lures for the Lost
SideQuest.text: Recover 4 lure-caches from the vents.
SideQuest.done: Every family has light again.

Name: R39
Subtitle: Realm of the Solar Throne
PeopleText: Golden-skinned folk who sleep only during eclipses.
Custom: Dawn-greeting: every Solari salutes the sun before they speak.

SideQuest.title: Eclipse
SideQuest.text: Clear 14 sun-creatures so we can reach the Eclipse Altar.
SideQuest.done: Night! Real night! Everyone is asleep in the streets.

Name: R40
Subtitle: Realm of Every Story
PeopleText: People made of ink and margin-notes who live inside books.
Custom: Re-reading: a beloved story is re-lived once a year, word for word.

SideQuest.title: The Blank Page
SideQuest.text: Find the Blank Page. It is where erased realms go.
SideQuest.done: You read the erased realms aloud. Some of them came back.

Name: R41
Subtitle: Realm That Died
PeopleText: Survivors of a realm whose god was eaten whole.
Custom: Ember-keeping: the last fire is never allowed to go out.

SideQuest.title: The Last Fire
SideQuest.text: Carry the Last Fire's embers to 4 old hearths so the realm stays warm.
SideQuest.done: Five fires now. Five!

Name: R42
Subtitle: Realm Split in Two
PeopleText: Twin nations of ice and flame who have not spoken in a thousand years.
Custom: The Line: no one may cross the boundary stones, ever.

SideQuest.title: Cross the Line
SideQuest.text: Visit both halls and carry word across. Start with the Hall of Flame.
SideQuest.done: Our nations will meet. First time in a thousand years.

Name: R43
Subtitle: Realm of the Fungal Mind
PeopleText: Mushroom-folk who share one dreaming mind.
Custom: Spore-sharing: memories are passed on by breathing together.

SideQuest.title: Weeding the Mind
SideQuest.text: Rot Blooms poison the shared mind. Clear 16.
SideQuest.done: We are thinking clearly. We think you are good.

Name: R44
Subtitle: Realm of the Seraphs
PeopleText: Six-winged guardians who tend gardens of living light.
Custom: Wing-vow: a seraph gives a feather to anyone they swear to protect.

SideQuest.title: Feathers Scattered
SideQuest.text: The fallen scattered our vow-feathers. Collect the 4 caches.
SideQuest.done: Every feather, home.

Name: R45
Subtitle: Realm of the Red Hunt
PeopleText: Wolf-folk who hunt under a moon that never sets.
Custom: The Howl: a pack chooses its leader by whose howl the moon answers.

SideQuest.title: Red Grass
SideQuest.text: Moonmad hunters roam the grass. Calm 16 of them.
SideQuest.done: The packs are howling together.

Name: R46
Subtitle: Realm of the Final Machine
PeopleText: Machine-people who calculated the end of the universe and found it boring.
Custom: Error-day: once a year everyone makes a mistake on purpose.

SideQuest.title: Deliberate Mistakes
SideQuest.text: Visit the Infinite Hall and make an error.
SideQuest.done: You walked the wrong way. Perfect.

Name: R47
Subtitle: Realm of Kind Dreams
PeopleText: Sleepy folk who build cities in shared dreams.
Custom: Dream-guesting: you may visit anyone's dream if you bring a gift.

SideQuest.title: A Gift for a Dream
SideQuest.text: Visit the Lullaby Tower and sing the children to sleep.
SideQuest.done: Snoring. Lovely, lovely snoring.

Name: R48
Subtitle: Realm of White Silence
PeopleText: Silent monks who believe Nihilus is coming and must be met with peace.
Custom: Vow of silence, broken once in a lifetime for the most important words.

SideQuest.title: One Word
SideQuest.text: Ring the Bell of One Word for the monks who cannot.
SideQuest.done: (He writes:) Thank you.

Name: R49
Subtitle: Heart of All Gates
PeopleText: The ancient builders who first tuned the Lattice.
Custom: The Great Measure: every star in every realm, counted once an age.

SideQuest.title: The Great Array
SideQuest.text: Calibrate the Great Array by clearing 18 phase-horrors from its rings.
SideQuest.done: Calibrated. The last gate is ready.

Name: R50
Subtitle: Beneath the Lattice
PeopleText: Echoes of every god and mortal Nihilus consumed.
Custom: They have none. They are waiting to be remembered.

SideQuest.title: Remember Them
SideQuest.text: Visit the Devoured Throng, and remember their names.
SideQuest.done: Every name, remembered.
